evals.prompt: Create a landing page for a luxury artisan candle brand called 'Lumina Scents'. The site needs to feel premium (glassmorphism, dark mode). Include Zelle payment instructions for 'payments@luminascents.com'. Ensure the page is SEO optimized for the keyword 'hand-poured luxury soy candles'.
evals.expected_output: A React component with premium CSS, clear Zelle payment instructions, and proper SEO meta tags/headers.
expectations: The background uses a dark, premium color palette.
A glassmorphism effect is applied to cards or panels.
Specific Zelle payment instructions are included with the email 'payments@luminascents.com'.
The meta title includes 'hand-poured luxury soy candles'.
There is exactly one <h1> tag containing a relevant SEO keyword.

evals.prompt: I need to optimize my product page for 'Pure Silk Pillowcases'. First, use the `scripts/seo_scraper.py` to analyze the SEO of 'https://www.blissy.com' (a top competitor). Then, rewrite my product description and meta tags based on their top keywords and structure to improve my ranking.
evals.expected_output: An SEO analysis report followed by optimized product content and meta tags.
expectations: The skill successfully executes `scripts/seo_scraper.py` on the competitor URL.
The output includes a summary of the competitor's top keywords.
The new meta description is less than 160 characters and includes 'Pure Silk Pillowcases'.
The product description uses <h2> tags for key benefits derived from the analysis.
